protocolRefs.multiCallChain: DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Parses an XML structure held in a BLOB or Text variable, optionally validating it against a DTD (either referenced inside the structure or explicitly designated by the dtd parameter), and returns a document reference.

discriminatedBy.rule: Third parameter is a DTD pathname/text (or omitted to use any DTD/XSD reference found inside the structure itself).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Parses an XML structure held in a BLOB or Text variable, optionally validating it against an XML Schema (XSD) explicitly designated by the schema parameter.

discriminatedBy.rule: Third parameter is an XSD file/URL pathname, selected instead of the dtd overload to validate by schema rather than DTD.

constraints: variable holds the raw XML structure itself (a BLOB or Text value), not a pathname.

If validation is True and the third parameter is omitted, validation is attempted via a DTD or XSD reference found inside the structure itself; this can chain (a referenced DTD that itself references an XSD).
If validation cannot be performed, an error is generated and reported via the Error system variable.
The returned reference must eventually be released by calling DOM CLOSE XML with it.

The dtd/schema overloads are not statically distinguishable by parameter type (both Text) -- 4D discriminates at runtime by file-extension convention (a ".dtd" path selects DTD validation, an ".xsd" path selects schema validation) or by content-sniffing, same as DOM Parse XML source.
